description: A called node does not close a soft link on its own before the minimum hold has passed: an idle close that falls due earlier waits, and is made when the minimum hold ends.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ at 0. Link setup as cas/make-called-accept: the peer's PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST (Ed4) at 2000, our PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED out at 52000, and the link made when that transmission ends at 57550 (B-0213, B-0400): link_state linked and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 (B-0215); the SIS of the called node declares the soft link established (A-0194), knowing from C_PHYSICAL_LINK_MADE that it is the called node (A-0325). As the called node it starts sis.soft_link_min_hold/0.0.1.3 with 60000, to 117550 (A-0197, A-0326), then sis.soft_link_max/0.0.1.3 with 3600000, which no other peer waits on (A-0322), then, with nothing outstanding, sis.soft_link_idle/0.0.1.3 with 10000 (A-0320). At 61000 the peer's first DATA C_PDU arrives, a DATA-ONLY (FSN 0) with 'ping' for SAP 9, which no client has bound, so the SIS discards it (A-0235); cas.first_data stops (B-0215, B-0403). The idle wait starts again, to 71000 (A-0320). At 62000 the burst ends with an acknowledgement owed: csma.vdcd_end 4000, then LBT rule 1 (K-0067) and 12000 ms of contention. At 71000 the idle wait expires within the minimum hold, so the called node does not close the link yet and nothing is output (A-0197, A-0326). At 78000 the ACK-ONLY (RX LWE 1, 15 bytes, 1 block) goes out, ending at 83550. At 117550 the minimum hold ends and the idle close that fell due is made: C_PHYSICAL_LINK_BREAK with Idle Soft Link Terminated (A-0205, A-0326). Nothing is outstanding and no acknowledgement is owed, so the link is clean and the CAS goes straight to Step 1 with no PHYSICAL LINK BREAK REQUEST (B-0278, B-0317, B-0421): link_state breaking, then LBT 3000 after our own transmission (K-0074) and contention. PHYSICAL LINK BREAK goes out at 165550 with reason 4 (B-0302), our C_PDU ID 1; cas.break from 171100. At 176000 the peer's PHYSICAL LINK BREAK CONFIRM: cas.break stops and link_state unlinked (B-0286). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10 for 1 block to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node), 0.0.1.3 and 0.0.1.4 take address size 3 (C-0133). A CAS-1 C_PDU of one octet in a type 8 D_PDU fills a block exactly (25 bytes; EOT and reception window 10), C_PDU IDs from 0 in each node's own sequence (C-1040), EOW 0. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000 ms (K-0080). Since corpus 0.28.0 (P7-3), every D_PDU this node sends to a peer recorded Ed4 carries EOW 0xF01, CAPABILITY (Ed4 1, Duplex 0), where it carried EMPTY (C-0426, C-1260); an owed UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR still goes first (C-1079), and D_PDUs to a peer of unknown edition, a peer recorded Ed3 or a group carry EMPTY as before. Where this note says EOW 0 or EMPTY for such a D_PDU, read CAPABILITY. Only EOW and header CRC bytes changed.
